checks.requirement: No AI provider credentials or server secrets in the app binary
No .env files bundled in the app
App never writes audio files (no AVAudioFile writing, AVAudioRecorder or AVAssetWriter)

Persisted (and iCloud-synced) models contain no audio-capable fields
Stopping a session clears the audio buffer and ends the Live Activity
A failed capture start clears the buffer and stops the microphone
